failure.message: Rolling ocp-dell-r650-tlv-64c-1024gb-DEL0000485 back (no Agent within 1:00:00): its BareMetalHost in multicluster-engine is still deleting 0:15:00 after the delete (metal3: state 'powering off before delete', operationalStatus 'error', error 'Failed to power off: BMC unreachable'). Its finalizer is left to metal3, which lets the host go only once it has powered it off and deleted its ironic node — usually it cannot reach the BMC. The NMStateConfig is deleted; nothing after the delete was done — no PXE unmap, no maintenance, no release — since a BareMetalHost still points at the machine, so its install lock runs to its expiry. Fix the BMC: metal3 finishes on its own
